Note: The CLM_PMT_AMT is the amount paid by Medicare for the routine  care costs under the Inpatient Prospective Payment System (IPPS) based on the MS-DRG classification.
The total amount actually paid to the hospital includes  an additional "pass-through" daily rate for overhead costs such as capital-related costs, direct medical education costs, bad debts, etc.
States can then choose how they want to report their data with options being:
1. Payment for routine services: CLM_PMT_AMT 
2. Total payment amount including additional overhead costs: Multiply CLM_PASS_THRU_PER_DIEM_AMT by CLM_UTLZTN_DAY_CNT and add it to CLM_PMT_AMT
3. Map to two separate columns providing the flexibility of using CLM_PMT_AMT alone or adding it to the CLM_PASS_THRU_PER_DIEM_AMT by CLM_UTLZTN_DAY_CNT
